purpose: Study Group Question Lab visibility / mount hotfix
root_cause: v11.60.45 injectUI created the new Question Lab only when #studyGroupCard did not already exist. When a prior study-group DOM was already mounted, the card was retained and the Question Lab section was not injected.
fixes: Always run ensureQuestionLabUI after study-group UI initialization.
Upgrade an already-existing study-group detail DOM by inserting the Question Lab before Daily Goals when the create tab is absent.
Repair a partially-mounted Question Lab section by replacing it when the create tab is missing.
Add prominent quick-entry buttons for 문제 풀기 and 문제 만들기 in the group date/action bar.
Add 문제 만들기 to an existing legacy goal-type select when absent.
Update cache-busting asset versions to v11.60.46.
